# Webix Solutions

> Webix Solutions (webixsolutions.com) is a full-service digital agency founded by Haroon Sukhera. A remote team of 20+ in Pakistan builds websites, online stores, custom CRM software and client portals, runs SEO and paid advertising, and sets up AI automation. It works directly with businesses and as a white-label partner for agencies. It is not affiliated with the Webix JavaScript UI library (webix.com).

## Key facts

- Founder and CEO: Haroon Sukhera
- Headquarters: Dunyapur, Punjab, Pakistan
- Clients in: Canada, the United States, the United Arab Emirates, New Zealand and Pakistan
- Contact: info@webixsolutions.com, +92 322 9472354 (phone and WhatsApp)
- Code: github.com/webixsolutions-dev

## Services

- [Website design and development](https://webixsolutions.com/web-design-development-service/): custom-coded Next.js sites and builds on WordPress, Shopify, Webflow and Framer.
- [Shopify store development](https://webixsolutions.com/shopify-store-development-services/): storefronts, migrations and checkout flows.
- [Mobile app development](https://webixsolutions.com/mobile-app-development-services/): iOS and Android apps built with Flutter.
- [Custom CRM and client portals](https://webixsolutions.com/custom-crm-development/): lead pipelines, booking dashboards, customer portals and internal tools.
- [SEO, AEO and GEO](https://webixsolutions.com/seo-services/): technical SEO, local search and content that answers customers' questions.
- [Google Business Profile optimisation](https://webixsolutions.com/google-business-profile-optimization/): local listings and Maps visibility.
- [Paid advertising](https://webixsolutions.com/paid-advertising-services/): Google, Meta and TikTok campaigns. Ad spend is paid by the client directly to the platform.
- [Social media management](https://webixsolutions.com/social-media-management/): content planning, posts and reels.
- [AI automation](https://webixsolutions.com/ai-automation-services/): customer intake, support assistants and workflow integrations with human approval steps.
- [AI chatbot development](https://webixsolutions.com/ai-chatbot-development/): website and WhatsApp assistants.
- [White-label agency partnerships](https://webixsolutions.com/white-label-partners/): unbranded delivery for agencies and IT companies.
- [All services](https://webixsolutions.com/services/)
